criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame dark and staged; 1, 3, 4, 6 and 7 pass most of the showstopper test. Frame 8 mannequins with a white collar artifact and a black chair slab; frame 9 walker a mannequin beside the walk; frame 5 rubbery sleeve, mitten hand, floating sheet.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck, one hero, the walk a real spine, both devices visible; 4 a void with a pale table, 8 a cooler interior.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every fact traces to a primary page; numerals computed or quoted; c18 honestly scoped. Slide 4's 'faculty and staff document' is looser than the source's access marking, and the drawn body lines nudge a reader to believe a policy exists.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who drafted, where and when are clear; slide 7 honest; the stake general, no county, and no URL for the form.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover is a topic; turns at 4 and 7 real; 5 goes back to the rules; 8 jumps back from October 22nd to 12th.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and restrained; two headlines describe the illustration; four deks end on a disclaimer.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New accent and hero; lastLight and one unit per day repeat no. 46; leaders to parts and a count of heroes repeat nos. 46 and 47.

one_sentence_fix: Put the tension on the cover and the action at the close, with the Ways to Get Involved form's URL in the first comment.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Kit mannequins with a white clip on every collar, a black chair slab in the lower left, the room in a grey mid dark.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Figures as silhouettes against the window's light, camera low behind the hero desk, the near chair out of frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stiff mannequin walker on the grass beside the walk, the desk small behind her.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop the walker to a back lit shoulder from the left with feet on the near paver, the desk a third of the frame height.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pale tube sleeve, mitten hand, sheet floating at an angle.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Sheet flat on the desk with a contact shadow, the sleeve darkened, the hand at the keys the one lit thing.
